A Ukrainian elderly woman sits inside Bread of Life Baptist Church in Kozelets, Ukraine, and waits for the service to start. Every Friday, the church, with the help of Send Relief, distributes more than 600 food packets to the community. The distribution happens every Friday. The church’s electricity is often powered by a generator donated by Send Relief.
